reviews.title: True gapless playback? Not so sure…
reviews.text: This used to be my preferred offline music player for quite a while until the “true gapless playback” update was released sometime in June or thereabouts. Since then, all the gapless albums I’ve tried playing have small gaps/blips during the transition from one track to another. I’ve disabled the EQ within the app, I don’t have any extra FX enabled, and I’ve tried both audio engines within the app, but nothing has solved the problem. I never had issues with gapless playback on the versions of the app prior to that update, but now it appears that the “true gapless playback” update has actually made things go from working normally to not working at all, as intended. It’s a bummer and has forced me to find another offline music player app that can properly handle playback of continuous DJ mixes and such.

reviews.title: Not responsive, charged twice
reviews.text: I used to LOVE this app and recommended it to so many people all the time, but when they raised their price for the yearly subscription (totally fine, I would’ve kept paying!) they ended up billing me multiple times - at the previous rate I paid and the new rate. I thought “sure, that’s a small issue with a simple solution,” yet I’ve reached out multiple times to get this sorted and get a refund for the erroneous subscriptions charges, keeping the active one. But I haven’t received a reply to any of my messages for going on 9 months! Obviously I am not renewing my subscription and will give Apple the feedback about this issue with their app because that’s absolutely crazy.

reviews.title: Excellent App, But It Needs Better Library Management
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Evermusic with a large offline library (around 2,000 MP3 files), and overall I really like the app and its interface. However, I’ve encountered several issues that make managing a large music collection difficult.

1. Newly added music is not detected automatically. When I add new audio files to the Evermusic folder, they do not appear in the library until I manually import or refresh them. The app should automatically detect newly added files.
2. Search indexing is inconsistent. Some songs cannot be found even though they exist in the library. If I open a song in the tag editor and simply save it again, it immediately becomes searchable. This suggests the search index is not updated correctly.
3. Search should work across all metadata fields. Currently, searching is inconsistent and does not reliably search all tags (Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, etc.). It should search every metadata field as well as filenames.
4. Please add a “Rebuild Library / Reindex Library” option. This would allow users to refresh the entire library without editing thousands of files one by one.
5. Importing or replacing files changes their order. The original file order is lost after importing or replacing tracks. Please provide an option to preserve the original order or allow manual sorting.
6. Batch tag editing needs more powerful tools. It would be very helpful to copy filenames into the Title tag, copy values between tag fields, and perform bulk metadata operations.
7. Dele
